Vital (GPLv3, see LICENSE), https://github.com/mtytel/vital
Commit 636ca0ef517a4db087a6a08a6a8a5e704e21f836 (2022-04-20), Vital 1.0.6's source.

What is here, as it is upstream unless listed below:
- src/synthesis/: Vital's synthesis engine, without effects_engine/ (VitalFX's).
- src/common/: what the engine and its presets need: synth_constants.h,
  synth_parameters, synth_types, line_generator, fourier_transform.h, tuning,
  load_save (trimmed, see below), wavetable/ (the wavetable creators).
- src/interface/look_and_feel/synth_strings.h: the parameters' value names.
- src/unity_build/: synthesis.cpp and common.cpp, the files Vital builds as.
- third_party/json (nlohmann's JSON 3.1.2, MIT): Vital's own copy. (Its
  KISS FFT isn't vendored: FourierTransform runs on KFR's, below.)

SUBstation's (not Vital's):
- compat/kfr_fourier_transform.cpp: Vital's FourierTransform on KFR (above).
- compat/JuceHeader.h: what the vendored files take from JUCE (leak detector
  and non-copyable macros, a std::string-based String, StringArray, File for
  tuning files, Base64, MemoryOutputStream, denormals off), so JUCE isn't needed.
- Local changes (local-changes.patch, against the commit above):
  - src/common/load_save.{h,cpp}: trimmed to the wave data conversions
    (convertBufferToPcm, convertPcmToFloatBuffer), the presets' upgrade from
    older versions (updateFromOldVersion), getAuthor, getLicense and comparing
    versions: the rest is Vital's application (SynthBase, its folders, its
    config file). The functions kept are unchanged.
  - src/unity_build/common.cpp: without the files of Vital's application
    (border_bounds_constrainer, midi_manager, startup, synth_gui_interface,
    synth_base), which aren't vendored; operators.h included first.
  - src/common/fourier_transform.h: a branch for SUBSTATION_KFR_FFT (after
    Intel IPP's) declaring FourierTransform, which compat/kfr_fourier_transform.cpp
    implements on KFR's real FFT (third_party/kfr) in the IPP build's layout.
    Upstream falls back on KISS FFT, which spent about 40 % of the
    instrument's time and dropped the Nyquist bin; here that fallback is an
    #error, and KISS FFT isn't vendored.

Not here: Vital's interface (its window, OpenGL), its plug-in and standalone
wrappers, its presets and wavetables (under their own licence, not
redistributable), JUCE.

SUBstation uses it for its built-in Vital instrument (engine/src/builtin/
devices/Vital.cpp, VitalPatch.h, VitalEngine.h). Vital's README asks that its
names ("Vital", "Vital Audio", "Tytel", "Matt Tytel") not be used to market or
to name a distribution of binaries built from it: see docs/licensing.md.
